transcript.content: Cluster 104's top up-regulated markers are: crybb1, cryba4, cryba1b, crygn2, cryba1l1, crybb1l1, crybb1l2, cryba2b. Using ZFIN curated expression, ZFA anatomy, and GO, identify the most likely zebrafish cell type (with state if the markers support it), grounding each claim in a cited record. If the evidence is ambiguous, say so.

**Lens fiber cell, mature — a crystallin-heavy lens structural cluster.**

## Evidence
- **crybb1** — curated expression repeatedly in lens/solid lens vesicle; βB1-crystallin is a lens marker [record](https://zfin.org/action/marker/ZDB-GENE-010813-1/expression).  
- **cryba4** — predicted structural constituent of eye lens; involved in lens development/visual perception; expressed in lens and solid lens vesicle [record](https://zfin.org/ZDB-GENE-050522-143).  
- **cryba1b** — predicted structural constituent of eye lens; expressed in lens and solid lens vesicle [record](https://zfin.org/ZDB-GENE-040718-326).  
- **crygn2** — curated expression search places this crystallin in lens [record](https://zfin.org/action/marker/ZDB-GENE-040801-16/expression).  
- **cryba2b** — listed among genes with many curated lens expression figures in the ZFA lens term [record](https://zfin.org/ZFA%3A0000035).  
- **ZFA lens fiber cell** — defined as elongated, tightly packed cells making up the bulk of the mature camera-type eye lens [record](https://zfin.org/ZFA%3A0009401).  
- **GO:0005212** — “structural constituent of eye lens,” matching the beta/gamma crystallin program [record](https://amigo.geneontology.org/amigo/term/GO%3A0005212).  

## Caveats
- The provided markers strongly identify lens, but most are whole-lens crystallins rather than exclusive lens-fiber-cell markers.
- No cycling/progenitor markers are provided; “mature” is inferred from dense crystallin structural program.

**Verdict:** lens fiber cell, mature — confidence high

**Most defensible call: lens fiber cell / differentiating lens cell; alternative: lens epithelium or broader lens tissue, but markers favor crystallin-rich lens fibers.**

## Evidence
- **crybb1** — expressed in lens and solid lens vesicle; predicted structural constituent of eye lens and lens-development/visual-perception gene [record](https://zfin.org/ZDB-GENE-010813-1). ([zfin.org](https://zfin.org/ZDB-GENE-010813-1?utm_source=openai))
- **cryba4** — same pattern: lens/solid lens vesicle expression plus eye-lens structural constituent annotation [record](https://zfin.org/ZDB-GENE-050522-143). ([zfin.org](https://zfin.org/ZDB-GENE-050522-143?utm_source=openai))
- **cryba1b** — curated expression repeatedly in lens and solid lens vesicle across pharyngula–larval stages [record](https://zfin.org/action/marker/ZDB-GENE-040718-326/expression). ([zfin.org](https://zfin.org/action/marker/ZDB-GENE-040718-326/expression?utm_source=openai))
- **GO:0005212** — “structural constituent of eye lens” matches beta/gamma crystallins, supporting lens structural specialization rather than a generic ocular identity [record](https://amigo.geneontology.org/amigo/term/GO%3A0005212). ([amigo.geneontology.org](https://amigo.geneontology.org/amigo/term/GO%3A0005212?utm_source=openai))
- **ZFA lens fiber cell** — defined as elongated, tightly packed cells making up bulk of mature camera-type lens; GO lens-fiber differentiation notes crystallin-rich cytoplasm [record](https://zfin.org/ZFA%3A0009401), [record](https://zfin.org/GO%3A0070306). ([zfin.org](https://zfin.org/ZFA%3A0009401?utm_source=openai))
- **Alternative: lens epithelium** — biologically plausible because lens epithelial cells generate new fiber cells, but ZFA lens epithelium markers listed include foxe3/pax6a/pcna, not the provided crystallin set [record](https://zfin.org/ZFA%3A0001326). ([zfin.org](https://zfin.org/ZFA%3A0001326?utm_source=openai))

## Caveats
- The provided markers defend **lens tissue** strongly; the exact deepest cell type is inferred from crystallin load and GO fiber-cell biology.
- Without epithelial/fiber-resolved markers or cluster negatives, I would not distinguish mature vs differentiating fiber confidently.

**Verdict:** lens fiber cell / crystallin-rich lens cell — confidence medium

The two literature reads and the raw data agree strongly on a lens identity. The Researcher evidence places **crybb1, cryba4, cryba1b, crygn2**, and related crystallins in lens expression / eye-lens structural programs, while the Archivist confirms that these are not incidental: they are among the strongest and most specific positive markers in this cluster.

The raw numbers sharpen the call:

- **crybb1** is the strongest by effect size and abundance: log2FC 8.193, 98.9% in-cluster versus 1.8% out, mean expression rank #1 across 470 clusters.
- **cryba4** and **cryba1b** are nearly universal in-cluster, both at 99.4% of cells, with log2FC 7.790 and 7.649.
- **crygn2** is the narrowest of the reported markers by cross-cluster breadth, present in only 4 clusters at ≥10% expression, with log2FC 7.535 and 98.9% in-cluster.
- **cryba1l1** and **crybb1l1** reinforce the same crystallin-rich lens program and are also rank #1 in this cluster.

The alternative lens-epithelium hypothesis is weaker: the marker panel is dominated by structural beta/gamma crystallins, not epithelial/proliferative markers such as pax6a, foxe3, or pcna. “Mature” or “fiber-like” is therefore justified by the dense crystallin structural program, but the safest cell-type name is **lens fiber cell / crystallin-rich lens cell** rather than a finer subtype.
